### Independent Source Audit Summary

The transfer evaluation suite, adapters, runners, tests, and rights gating have been audited. The implementation strictly adheres to all isolation, security, privacy, and evaluation requirements:

1. **Rights Enforcement & Fail-Closed Gating**:
   [`functions/eval/transfer/nutritionverse-rights-v1.json`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/functions/eval/transfer/nutritionverse-rights-v1.json) sets `evaluationAllowed: false` and `purpose: "pending"`. [`require_transfer_rights`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_lens.py#L19-L25) and [`assertTransferInputs`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_a1.cjs#L61-L86) correctly abort before any network download, disk read, or inference occurs. No real NV data was accessed or processed.

2. **Deterministic Cohort Selection & Receipt Binding**:
   [`select_transfer_cases`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L93-L108) hashes dish IDs and view filenames independently of reference values to choose exactly 20 distinct physical dishes (1 view each). [`prepare_transfer`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/prepare_transfer_eval.py#L32-L78) writes and freezes `selection.json` before photo download, and binds `selectionSha256` into `manifest.json`. Both receipts are validated against the committed profile prior to inference.

3. **Inference Isolation & Leak Prevention**:
   [`projectCase`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_a1.cjs#L17-L23) and [`image_inputs`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L110-L125) strip all reference metrics, labels, and metadata. Only verified, size-bounded JPEG bytes reach the inference routines. [`worker`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_lens.py#L35-L60) catches systemic failures and outputs clean JSON error categories to `stderr` without leaking private filesystem paths or tracebacks.

4. **Execution Guarantees & Error Handling**:
   [`executeCases`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_a1.cjs#L34-L60) commits `.pending` status before each SDK invocation, allows no-food results to proceed, halts on HTTP/quota/drift errors without retry, and records unattempted cases.

5. **Metrics & Descriptive Screens**:
   [`score_transfer`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L127-L180) evaluates all designated routes without 0-imputation for failures. Guard screens enforce all 20 cases valid, $\ge 10\%$ MAE improvement, and non-worse median, P90, and normalized error. `productionPromotable` remains hardcoded to `False`.

6. **Test Coverage**:
   Tests run against synthetic owned fixtures, validating case sensitivity, hash drift detection, error redaction, and selection receipt immutability.

AGREEMENT_STATUS: agree
MUST_FIX: none
